verdict.rationale: Cookbook docs disclose the general approach behind headline numbers (e.g., 'one TypeSafe question per query-candidate pair' for the 5%→18%/38%→62% rerank claim, or 'batching every question into one call' for the 12.2x/10x claim), but none name the underlying eval/benchmark dataset, provide exact prompts/state text, sample sizes, or a runnable harness for independent reproduction. Community commentary explicitly flags this gap ('they talk as skeptics but don't offer a ton of evidence, other than a couple videos of demos... a live demo would be far more convincing'), and a separate technical critique of calibration/confidence claims (order-dependence, 'confidence is fake') further shows outside auditors could not fully verify the claims from what's published. Missing for 10: named benchmark/eval suite, exact prompts or state inputs used, dataset provenance, sample sizes/statistical methodology, and an open harness or script for third-party reproduction.
